plugin_dirs.description: dsh plugin directories, separated by semicolon/comma/newline. Example: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\plugins\dsh-memewiki

node_path.description: node executable path. Empty means auto-detect the dsh desktop runtime, then system node

inject_prompt.description: Merge ctx.systemPrompt.context output into every LLM request

mcp_mode.description: Also expose tools as an MCP stdio server
